{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Iconography in the Age of Xim''''' was a study of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]-era iconography written by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] historian [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]]. The study, which was considered groundbreaking by the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]], concluded that the "sole-surviving" floating fortress from [[Xim's empire]], on display at [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]], displayed evidence of more recent [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] manufacture to an [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] architectural style. Hextrophon's conclusion led to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] preventing any further academic studies of the station.<ref name="Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref> Hextrophon also studied [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-iconography from the same period.<ref name="HSatCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
